hero.title: The Pinnacle of Purity
hero.paragraph: A state-of-the-art line powered by advanced American RO filtration. Luxurious glass-bottled drinking water that protects your health and elevates your company's sustainable image.
hero.imageAlt: AVARIS 450ml glass bottle - premium still water

storytelling.quote: Among the first waters that nourished ancient civilisations, there was a place called Avaris - where water was not only life, but the memory of the Earth itself.
storytelling.story: AVARIS is more than a bottle of water. AVARIS is a journey back to untouched purity, back to unspoiled nature, and back to the responsibility of protecting our blue planet.
storytelling.promiseBefore: Sealed in glass that can be reborn endlessly, every bottle of AVARIS preserves not only the fresh, natural taste of pure water, but also a promise:

journey.title: The Sustainable Journey of an AVARIS Glass Bottle
journey.intro: We control every step with rigour - from sterilising the first returned bottle to the moment pure water reaches your hands, and finally to collecting that bottle so it can be reborn.
journey.hint: Click any step on the circle to see how the process works

steps.title: 5-step rinsing & UV sterilisation
steps.desc: Every AVARIS glass bottle - whether returned or about to enter the filling line - goes through a sealed five-step cleaning process combined with advanced ultraviolet (UV) sterilisation. This removes bacteria and ultra-fine impurities completely, delivering impeccable cleanliness.
steps.accent: Absolute protection for your health - certified to international HACCP food safety standards.

steps.title: Advanced American water filtration
steps.desc: Our system applies the most advanced reverse osmosis (RO) technology from the United States. Heavy metals, chemical residues and dissolved salts are removed entirely, leaving only the purest water molecules with a soft, naturally sweet taste.
steps.accent: Quality control meeting the most stringent standards of the US FDA.

steps.title: Automated filling in a sterile environment
steps.desc: Once filtered, the pure water flows directly into a fully enclosed automated filling system. The filling area meets international cleanroom standards, eliminating any risk of recontamination from outside air.
steps.accent: Automation raises consistency and delivers optimal quality in every single drop.

steps.title: On-time delivery to our partners
steps.desc: We understand that time is precious to your business. AVARIS has built a dedicated delivery team and a modern logistics process, promising punctual delivery straight to your hotel, restaurant, resort or office.
steps.accent: Reliable supply with rapid emergency support, 24/7.

steps.title: A premium drinking experience
steps.desc: For the first time, drinking water is not merely about quenching thirst - it becomes a genuine art of enjoyment. An elegant glass design with superior chill retention brings refreshing delight to every high-end meeting or banquet.
steps.accent: An elegant bottle that adds to the refinement of any banquet table or hotel room.

steps.title: Collected for sustainable reuse
steps.desc: Once used, every glass bottle is collected through our professional management system to be washed and regenerated in a circular loop. No shard of glass and no plastic shell is left behind in nature.
steps.accent: A powerful statement of our green commitment, cutting the pressure of plastic waste to a minimum.
